items.mainDefect: The copy test checks only the success toast, so it passes even when clipboard copying fails or copies incorrect content.

secondary.defect: The component shows a success toast without awaiting clipboard.writeText, so it reports success even if the write fails.

items.mainDefect: resetState leaves backupCodes and backupCodesUrl populated, retaining stale codes and their blob URL after the modal closes.

secondary.defect: resetState also leaves dataUri and secret uncleared.
